narrative: Decision-rules audit for the bugzilla-evergreen build. In scope: every service with a SERVICE_SPEC.md under output/phase-5-specification/specs/ — currently service-attachment, service-bug, service-comment, service-notification, service-product, service-search, and service-user (7 services). Rule IDs use the convention BR-{svc}-NNN for numbered Business Rules, BR-{svc}-PERM-{Cmd} for Layer-1 permissions, BR-{svc}-POLICY-{ClassName} for Layer-2 policies, BR-{svc}-ST-{From}-{To} for state transitions, and BR-{svc}-NOTIF-{EventName} for notification triggers. The synthesizer will concatenate every per-service Master Table into one project-wide Master Table at audit-output/decision-rules.md, then build 5 category sub-sections (state-transition / permission / validation / business-policy / notification), then surface duplicates and unclear-intent rules.

slices.title: Decision rules for service-attachment
slices.focus: Mine ## Business Rules (numbered list), ## Authorization (Layer 1 permissions + Layer 2 policy classes), ## State Machines (transition tables), ## Validation / Field Validation, and ## Notifications. Target ≥10 rules — attachments are a supporting aggregate with file-type and size constraints.
